newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit recovers slightly on exporter selling.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit recovers slightly on exporter selling.

text.p: * Ringgit recovers slightly on exporters selling interest around 2.5150
* Ringgit also supported by weaker dollar/yen
* Dollar/ringgit seen retaining firm bias on offshore demand
The ringgit recovered slightly against the dollar on Wednesday morning on dollar selling by exporters, dealers said.
The dollar's fall on Wednesday morning to its lowest level against the yen since November 1996 also helped the ringgit's recovery, they said.
"Exporters are selling the dollar around 2.5150 and this is capping the dollar/ringgit's rise," said a dealer with a European bank in Kuala Lumpur. "But the dollar could firm back later in the day."
Strong buying from two U.S. hedge funds at the 2.5100 level pushed the dollar/ringgit to a high of 2.5160 in late Asian trading on Tuesday.
Dealers said many funds were still short dollar and were looking to cover their positions.
At 0230 GMT, the ringgit was quoted at 2.5130/40 a dollar against 2.5145/55 at Kuala Lumpur close on Tuesday.
